contexts.text: (A Spirit who said he was nothing, detected from afar.)
To see from afar = to foresee.
A nation from afar, from the extremity of the earth = evils and falsities, or those who are in them.
To come from afar = that they are remote from the light that is from the Lord.
They saw him (Joseph) afar off = perception of the Lord's Divine Human remotely.
Sons from far = truths with the Gentiles.
They stood afar off (from Sinai) = remoteness from inward things.
The reason of the signification of afar off explained.
Afar off = remoteness from the good and truth which are from the Divine, thus from inward things. Illustrated. AC 8927.
Bow yourselves afar off = humiliation and adoration from the heart, and then the influx of the Lord.
The reason why afar off = from the heart is that they who are in humiliation remove themselves from the Lord...
Sons from afar = those who are in obscurity as to truths.
Extremity is predicated of good, and afar, of truth.
A still more remote Earth visited... Remoteness there is from difference of state.
[Swedenborg footnote 2.] That a man can be carried far away as to his spirit by changes of state. References.

Nature of appearances at a distance there. DP 117:end. AR 455:2. AR 601:2. AR 611:4. AR 655:3. AR 835:2. AR 875. AR 878:end. CL 42:2. CL 75:4. [CL 76. CL 76:2. CL 78:2. CL 137. CL 265. CL 339:end. CL 510:end. CL 512. CL 514:3. CL 521. TCR 13:end. TCR 664.
Afar off = remoteness of state.
Remoteness of state, which is remoteness in the spiritual sense. Illustrated. AR 783. AR 787.
I inquired from afar. TCR 694.
Such are heard speaking as if they were afar off.
From far = distant and removed from goods and truths.
From afar is said of goods in the natural man; near, of those in the spiritual man.
Afar off = remote from truths of the Church that are spiritual.
They shall look upon the land of lengths.... Land = the Church and Heaven, and length, extension there.
A far country = the Lord's departure from the world, and as it were absence.
Far and the end of the earth = removal from the light of truth, because in falsities from ignorance, because they have not the Word, or do not understand its meaning.
Afar off = what is outward. Explained. AE 1133:3. Illustrated.
Afar off, in the opposite sense, = what is evil. Illustrated.
